vulnerability_analysis: The TokenTool contract has an owner-only function `multipleBotlistAddress()` that can blacklist any address. When an address is blacklisted, it cannot send or receive tokens due to the check in `_transfer()`. This is an owner privilege abuse vulnerability where the owner can arbitrarily restrict any address from trading while continuing to trade normally themselves.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call `multipleBotlistAddress()` to blacklist a victim address. This will set `_isBlacklisted[victim] = true`, satisfying the oracle verification.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the owner address from the contract. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Call multipleBotlistAddress() with an array containing the victim address and excluded=true. 4. Verify that _isBlacklisted[victim] is now true.
